snapshotNote: Snapshot 12:49 UTC 6 Oct · Tuesday 06:49 Mexico City · Week 5, nothing has kicked off · waivers process Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City · this brief does not refresh on its own
sources: Built from 151 web searches this run, made by six research passes; I ran none myself and read their reports · NFL.com, NBC Sports/PFT, NBC Sports Philadelphia, CBS Sports, RotoWire, Yahoo, SI, AP, FOX 9, Bring Me The Sports, Heavy, Athlon, PFF, A to Z Sports, The Liberty Line, commanders.com, vikings.com, packers.com, Bleacher Nation, Bleacher Report, The Fantasy Footballers, DraftSharks, FantasyData, FantasyPros, PlayerProfiler, PFN, Sportsnaut, FootballDB, DraftEdge, SteelerNation · ESPN league file (12:49 UTC 6 Oct), week archives 1–4

tonight.headline: 0–4, and Week 5 opens as a coin flip
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4 after losing 120.4 to 153.6, and three of your five bench seats hold receivers who have no ruling for Sunday. ESPN projects Week 5 at 114.0 to 118.3 against Los Gigantes de Teca and gives you 48%.

What you can do today is small. Put Gordon in the flex over Kamara, a one-point coin flip that goes to the projection, and make no claim tonight. Wednesday's practice reports on Jefferson and McLaurin are the next thing that can change the lineup.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, is in the concussion protocol and 'day-to-day' (Zac Taylor, 5 Oct). Chuba Hubbard sits in their flex on a bye at 0.0, so their 118.3 rises once they fix it. Purdy 18.0, McBride 18.8, London 16.7, Irving 15.4.

case.label: Your side
case.body: Allen 20.1, Warren 14.6, Wilson 14.6, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Addison 11.1, the flex at 11.0, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 8.1. Jefferson active would add about seven points to that.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson practising on Wednesday or Thursday, on your side. Chase being ruled out, on theirs.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Flex: Gordon over Kamara, on the projection
doFirst.subtitle: A one-point coin flip, 11.0 to 10.0. It goes to the projection, and it is the only change the lineup check asks for.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 113.9; the projection lineup is 114.9. The whole gap is this slot. Inside two points ESPN is right 56% of the time, so this is a coin flip and gets no thesis.

case.label: Why not last night's 22.8
case.body: Kamara's Monday was two touchdowns from 3 and 5 yards on 7 carries. He played 28 snaps, 38%, level with rookie CJ Donaldson, who took the third downs, and he went to the medical tent with a knee in the third quarter before returning (Athlon; PFF; AOL, 5–6 Oct). Minnesota are 4th against running backs. Starting him on that score would be the mistake that cost 42.8 points in the other league.

case.label: Gordon's side
case.body: Jaylen Wright started on Sunday and ran 5 times for 7; Gordon ran 9 times for 100 and RotoWire says he 'stakes strong claim to starting job'. His coach has named nobody. Miami are 0–4, 7.5-point underdogs, and threw for 85 yards.

case.label: Monangai is the third option
case.body: He projects 10.6, between the two, with a thumb listed questionable and 'going to be OK' (Ben Johnson). All three are within a point. I have no news on any of them that ESPN lacks.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara outscores Gordon on Sunday (archive). On a coin flip that happens almost half the time, which is why nothing goes in the decision log.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · Athlon · PFF · AOL · NBC Sports · RotoWire · Week 4 archive

whatWentWrong.title: No claim tonight: the condition was Jefferson being ruled out, and he hasn't been
whatWentWrong.lead: Yesterday's brief made the Metcalf claim depend on one thing. Tuesday morning has no ruling on Jefferson, McLaurin or Coker, and the one seat a claim could use holds a player ESPN rates above Metcalf.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Jefferson: 'I don't have any real projection on whether we'll have him or not' (O'Connell, 4 Oct), with nothing written since. McLaurin: 'I'll give you a better update for him for Wednesday' (Quinn, 5 Oct). Coker: 'return expected after bye week' (Canales's Monday press conference, via Yahoo). All three first practise, or don't, on Wednesday, after claims process at 01:00.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: You are first in this week's waiver order, so a claim would succeed. It still isn't worth making. Metcalf projects 12.0, which is 0.9 above Addison and 1.0 above the flex: one coin flip's worth this week. The seat would be Coker's, and ESPN's season number has Coker at 179.7 to Metcalf's 153.4 with a Week 6 return expected. That is a week of availability bought with a player rated higher. It connects to the card above because the flex is the only slot a claim would have touched.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker going on injured reserve, or a report before 01:00 Wednesday that he will miss Week 6. Either makes his seat idle for a month and Metcalf the right use of it. After 01:00 Metcalf is a free agent if nobody claims him, and the same test applies on Thursday.

whatWentWrong.sources: Bring Me The Sports · commanders.com · Yahoo · ESPN league file

whatWentWrong.title: Week 4 finished 120.4 to 153.6, with 19.3 on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 22.8 on Monday night took you from 97.6 to 120.4. Aye-Aye had 153.6. The best lineup you could have set scores 139.7.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Archive: Monangai 28.0 and Gordon 18.0 sat behind Tuten's 11.1 and Warren's 15.6. Three receivers were inactive. No brief overrode the projection in those slots; the projection lost them. The flex, where Kamara replaced the inactive Coker, is where a brief did act, and Monangai was 5.2 better there.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the rule, and that is the point of the card above. One week in which the bench backs won doesn't make them the starters: Tuten and Warren project 14.0 and 14.6 again, three or more above all three bench backs. The 19.3 would not have won the week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A role change reported after the projection is set: Dowdle confirmed active for Pittsburgh, Swift named the starter in Chicago, or Wright named the starter in Miami. None of those has happened.

roster.footnote: Snapshot 06:49 Mexico City, Tuesday. No Week 5 game has kicked off, so every row shows its matchup. starting.name: Bhayshul Tuten

starting.name: Jaylen Warren
starting.detail: PIT · vs IND · SUN 11:00 · Dowdle may return · Rodgers
starting.gradeEvidence: 25th vs RB (FootballDB, standard, through Wk 4); 22nd by DraftEdge

report.availability: ACTIVE — no injury reported since Thursday's game
report.role: 17 carries for 93 and 3 catches on 6 targets for 33: 15.6 (archive). Every backfield carry in Weeks 3 and 4; 220 rushing yards in those two games (The Fantasy Footballers, 2 Oct)
report.competition: Rico Dowdle (toe) missed Weeks 3 and 4. Mike McCarthy: a positive workout on Friday, 'making progress', and a 'one-two punch' with Warren when he is back (RotoWire; NBC Sports, 5 Oct). Rapoport gave him 'a pretty good chance' of Week 5 (FantasyPros, 1 Oct). Not confirmed either way
report.passer: Aaron Rodgers, healthy: 22 of 40 for 299, three touchdowns, two interceptions
report.checked: RotoWire and NBC Sports, 5 Oct; The Fantasy Footballers, 2 Oct. ROLE_UP and VACATED answered: the 100% share is Dowdle's absence. ESPN moved Warren from 17.0 last week to 14.6 and gives Dowdle 8.0 while still listing him OUT, so a return looks at least half priced. Pittsburgh lost DT Derrick Harmon to injured reserve (SteelerNation, 5 Oct)
report.summary: Start. He has been the whole backfield for two weeks. Dowdle may return on Sunday and ESPN has already taken 2.4 off his number.

starting.name: Garrett Wilson
starting.detail: NYJ · vs CLE · SUN 11:00 · Geno Smith · total 40.5
starting.gradeEvidence: 27th vs WR (FootballDB, standard, through Wk 4); 15th by DraftEdge — they disagree

report.availability: ACTIVE — no injury; he cleared a concussion evaluation on 27 Sep (NBC Sports)
report.role: 3 catches on 4 targets for 27: 5.7 (archive). Targets 7, 7, 13, 4. The Jets ran 32 plays to Chicago's 89, went 0 for 7 on third down and threw 15 passes (AP; SI, 4 Oct). Wilson: 'I want more on my plate, for sure'
report.competition: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has missed two games and is 'week-to-week' (Aaron Glenn, 1 Oct); no return date. Isaiah Williams is the second receiver, with one 58-yard touchdown. Kenyon Sadiq had 0 catches on 4 targets; Mason Taylor (thumb) was out
report.passer: Geno Smith, healthy: 8 of 15 for 119, sacked three times
report.checked: AP, SI and RotoWire, 4 Oct; CBS and NBC Sports on Mitchell, 1–2 Oct, nothing newer. VACATED answered: Mitchell is still out and his targets did not arrive, because nobody's did on 15 attempts. ESPN cut Wilson from 16.5 to 14.6. Jets −2.5
report.summary: Start. Four targets came from a game in which the Jets threw 15 passes. Mitchell is still out and Cleveland are 27th against receivers by one count, 15th by another.

starting.gradeEvidence: 13th vs WR (FootballDB, standard, through Wk 4); 7th by DraftEdge

report.role: 4 catches on 6 targets for 52, with a 21-yard catch called back: 9.1 (archive). Targets 2, 5, 9, 6
report.competition: Justin Jefferson (ankle) has no projection for Sunday. With him out, T.J. Hockenson and not Addison became the first read: 13 targets, a 40% share (CBS, 4 Oct; SI, 5 Oct)

Left guard Donovan Jackson is out for the season with a torn meniscus and left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in the concussion protocol (FOX 9, 5 Oct). 13 sacks in four games (FantasyPros)

QB_CHANGE answered: Murray, healthy, and Kevin O'Connell was 'very encouraged' by how he finished. The line injuries were reported on Monday afternoon, before this number. The game is in New Orleans; Minnesota −1.5

starting.name: Isaiah Likely
starting.gradeEvidence: 30th vs TE (FootballDB, standard, through Wk 4); 30th by DraftEdge

report.role: 7 catches on a team-high 12 targets for 66: 13.6 (archive). Targets 8, 10, 5, 12; 22 catches on the season (Yahoo, 5 Oct)
report.competition: Malik Nabers: 6 catches for 112 and a touchdown. Braxton Berrios was hurt in the game

starting.name: Alvin Kamara
starting.detail: NO · vs MIN · SUN 11:00 · 38% of snaps on Monday · Shough
starting.gradeEvidence: 4th vs RB (FootballDB, standard, through Wk 4); 2nd by DraftEdge

report.availability: ACTIVE — a knee scare in the third quarter on Monday: medical tent, listed questionable, back before the quarter ended (PFF, 5 Oct; AOL, 6 Oct). He had an MCL sprain earlier this season. No post-game word from Kellen Moore

bench.name: Terry McLaurin
bench.detail: WSH · vs NYG · SUN 11:00 · ESPN lists him OUT; update due Wednesday · Jayden Daniels expected back

report.availability: ESPN: OUT. Hamstring; inactive in London after he 'pushed to play' (RotoWire, 5 Oct). Dan Quinn: 'We're still evaluating. I'll give you a better update for him for Wednesday' (commanders.com, 5 Oct)

bench.name: Jalen Coker
bench.detail: CAR · BYE · quad; expected back after the bye

lineupCheck.verdict: One change, and it is a coin flip: the projection has Gordon (11.0) in the flex over Kamara (10.0). Take it and write no thesis; everything else as set is the projection lineup.

worthALook.name: DK Metcalf
worthALook.lead: Carried from yesterday as the receiver to claim. Today's answer is no, and here is the one thing that reverses it.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5 catches on 9 targets for 115 on Thursday, 16.5 (archive); targets 10, 9, 5, 9, which is 33 in four games. No injury (The Fantasy Footballers; NBC Sports, 2 Oct). Rodgers threw 40 times. The Steelers receiver the columns recommend is Roman Wilson, because Metcalf isn't available anywhere else.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: The drop. Coker is the only seat without an injured teammate or an open hold, and ESPN's season number has him at 179.7 to Metcalf's 153.4. Coker is expected back for Week 6. This week Metcalf would add 0.9 over Addison.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Coker goes on injured reserve or is reported out past Week 6. You are first in the order, so a claim made before Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City would succeed; after that he is a free agent if unclaimed.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · The Fantasy Footballers · NBC Sports · Yahoo · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Denzel Boston
worthALook.lead: Carried from yesterday as Metcalf's alternative. The same seat problem applies.

case.label: The role
case.body: 4 catches on 7 targets for 89 with a 60-yarder, 12.9 (archive); 13 catches, 284 yards and two touchdowns on 22 targets (The Fantasy Footballers, 2 Oct). Deshaun Watson 'has earned more starts' (Fowler via NBC Sports). Week 5 is at the Jets.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 4, 7, 4, 7 against Metcalf's 10, 9, 5, 9. Cleveland want KC Concepcion more involved (Fowler), and he led them with 8 targets on Thursday. You dropped Boston on 1 Oct.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Not this week. Second choice behind Metcalf, and only on the same condition: Coker's seat going idle for a month.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · The Fantasy Footballers · NBC Sports

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: Carried: the back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns, and that may be Sunday.

case.label: The role
case.body: Missed Weeks 3 and 4 with a toe injury. Mike McCarthy: a positive workout on Friday, 'making progress', and a 'one-two punch' with Warren (RotoWire; NBC Sports, 5 Oct). With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs and no free seat. ESPN still lists him OUT at 8.0.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. His practice status on Wednesday matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

worthALook.sources: RotoWire · NBC Sports · FantasyPros · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Joe Mixon
doNotChase.lead: The wire's biggest riser, +6.51. He signed, but to a practice squad.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Seattle signed him to the practice squad on Monday, pending a physical (PFT/NBC Sports; DraftSharks, 5 Oct). Mike Macdonald said they are 'going through the process'.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: He hasn't played since January 2025 and needs an elevation to dress. Emanuel Wilson had 21 carries and 4 targets on Sunday, and Zach Charbonnet's practice window is open. No projection.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An elevation to the 53 and a coach describing a role.

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Every column's top pickup this week. A sixth back for you, against the 2nd-ranked run defence.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Tank Bigsby is going on injured reserve after core-muscle surgery and Saquon Barkley is week-to-week, so Shipley is the only healthy back on Philadelphia's roster (NFL.com; PFT, 5 Oct). Yahoo and RotoWire both lead their waiver columns with him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 6 carries for 23 on 29 snaps: 2.3 (archive). He projects 7.8, below all five of your backs, and Jacksonville are 2nd against running backs. Philadelphia threw for 93 yards on Sunday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for a month, and one of your backs ruled out with him.

doNotChase.sources: NFL.com · PFT · Yahoo · RotoWire · Week 4 archive

doNotChase.name: Tyreek Hill
doNotChase.lead: Carried, and still rising: Kansas City have called his agent. He still has no team.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Tyquan Thornton needs ankle surgery and is out three to four months; the Chiefs have contacted Hill's agent (CBS, citing The Athletic, 4–5 Oct). Travis Kelce: 'I'd be excited by what he could do here.'

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No signing. He is recovering from a knee dislocation with torn ligaments from September 2025, and 'ready by November' is his agent's word. Three of your five bench seats already hold receivers who may not play this week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A signing, then a practice.

doNotChase.sources: CBS Sports · AP · ESPN league file

case.label: The number that kills it

doNotChase.name: Bears D/ST
doNotChase.lead: Carried: NFL.com's top waiver defence. Yours projects higher this week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: NFL.com and Yahoo both list them as a Week 5 add; Sportsnaut ranks them 4th.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 7.3 against your Vikings' 8.1 (league file). DraftSharks has Chicago 23rd at Green Bay and PFN 13th; Minnesota are 7th and 4th.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Week 6: Minnesota are on bye and you need a defence for one week. Chicago play Atlanta then. That is next Tuesday's decision.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · PFN · DraftSharks · Sportsnaut · NFL.com

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried: Yahoo's receiver add of the week, in an offence that threw for 85 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 5 catches on 5 targets for 67 and 2 carries, 12.0 (archive); target shares of 28% and 29% in the last two weeks (Yahoo, 5 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 from Malik Willis, who was 9 of 17 for 85. Miami are off in Week 6, the same week as your Vikings.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Carried: six targets with Smith out, and the columns prefer a different Eagle.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith is 'out indefinitely' with a hamstring (NBC Sports Philadelphia, 6 Oct). Lemon played 45 snaps, 74%.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7 (archive). Darius Cooper played 55 snaps, caught both touchdowns and is the one RotoWire recommends.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

doNotChase.sources: Week 4 archive · NBC Sports Philadelphia · RotoWire

waiverAnalysis.summary: Four receivers clear the tool's bar, and the bar is partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. None has a role reason strong enough to act on, and nothing clears at running back or tight end.

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: 9 targets and two touchdowns against Buffalo, with a longest catch of 15 yards: 'the TDs carried his day' (DraftSharks). FantasyData calls him New England's top receiver and a sell-high. A.J. Brown, now a Patriot, is on injured reserve and hoped back by Week 6 (NBC Sports, 4 Oct), which is when the targets get competition.
rising.action: WATCH — one nine-target game, with the team's best receiver due back in a week

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: A Bengals rookie who drew 9 targets only after Ja'Marr Chase left with a concussion and Tee Higgins hurt his groin; Burrow threw 54 times. Both are day-to-day and neither is ruled out (Zac Taylor, 5 Oct). Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role exists only if Chase and Higgins both sit

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 82 against New England, his best game of the season (RotoWire, 5 Oct). DJ Moore aggravated a shoulder injury in the same game and is uncertain for the Rams; if he sits, RotoWire expects the extra targets to be shared with Keon Coleman and Dalton Kincaid.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore missing Monday night, which Schefter calls not long-term

rising.name: KC Concepcion
rising.roleReason: The steadiest of the four: 5, 6, 9, 8 targets, and Fowler reports the Browns want Watson to get him more involved (NBC Sports, 1 Oct). The volume is real and the production isn't yet: 7.6 a game.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role at 7.6 points a game; behind Metcalf if Coker's seat ever opens
rising.sources: NBC Sports · The Fantasy Footballers · Week 1–4 archive

settled.title: Kamara in the flex once McLaurin and Coker were out (the contingency, 2–4 Oct)
settled.result: Archive: Kamara 22.8, but Monangai, still unlocked when the swap was made, scored 28.0. Closed WRONG by 5.2, as its own falsifier said.

settled.title: 'Start Kamara in the flex; bench Coker' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Coker was inactive and scored 0; Kamara scored 22.8 (archive). Closed RIGHT.

settled.title: If Jefferson is inactive, add Addison and start him (30 Sep)
settled.result: It fired. Archive: Addison 9.1, Kamara 22.8. The falsifier named Kamara, so it closes WRONG. Boston, the player you dropped for him, scored 12.9.

settled.title: Dropping Kyle Pitts on usage (22 Sep)
settled.result: Archive: Likely beat him 3.3 to 1.5 and 13.6 to 7.7, so the two-of-three clause can't fire. His snap share was 59% in Week 3 and I could not get a figure for Monday; PFF says 'typical 2026 levels'. Closed RIGHT on the scores.

settled.title: Tuten in the RB slot over the bench backs (the projection lineup)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.1, Monangai 28.0, Gordon 18.0. No brief overrode the projection; the projection lost.

settled.title: 'Fairbairn is 0.5 better; under a point isn't a move' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: You made the swap. Archive: Fairbairn 16, Pineiro 5. The hold closed WRONG by 11.

settled.title: 'Monangai is not the drop until the thumb is known' (4–5 Oct)
settled.result: Still 'day to day' and 'going to be OK' on Tuesday. The hold stands and his seat stays closed.

settled.title: 'The claim turns on whether Jefferson is ruled out on Tuesday' (Monday's brief)
settled.result: He wasn't, and nothing was published either way. No claim tonight.

settled.title: Claim Gordon for Achane: 'under 12 touches in Week 4 means a timeshare' (28 Sep)
settled.result: He had 11 touches, so it closed WRONG as written, and scored 18.0. The clause was badly written; the claim gained.

cannotSee.label: Three receivers, no rulings
cannotSee.body: Jefferson, McLaurin and Coker have nothing new on Tuesday morning. ESPN lists all three OUT while projecting Jefferson at 18.2 and McLaurin at 13.2, which contradicts itself. The first practice reports are Wednesday afternoon, after claims process.

cannotSee.label: Whether the projection has Monday night
cannotSee.body: Kamara's 10.0 was published after his game. I can't see when ESPN last recomputed it, so 'priced' for Monday's news is an inference from the timestamp.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own, and the league file carries none. You are first of ten in this week's order. Everyone on the wire is on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Every tile comes from FootballDB's points allowed through Week 4, which is standard scoring and four games deep. DraftEdge, undated and full PPR, disagrees by ten places or more on Cleveland against receivers (27th or 15th) and Cincinnati against backs (11th or 25th). The Giants against receivers, for McLaurin, was not researched.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Keaton Mitchell, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee aren't on the published wire, so their availability in this league is the screen's inference that nobody rosters them.

cannotSee.label: Sources that disagree
cannotSee.body: Swift was benched (SI) or wasn't hurt and wasn't discussed (his coach). Monangai's imaging showed nothing structural by one summary that I could not confirm against its page. Kamara had 7 carries (four outlets and the archive) or 5 (AOL). Minnesota 'haven't scored a touchdown since Week 1' (Yahoo), which another box score contradicts. Dowdle's return is 'a pretty good chance' (Rapoport) and unconfirmed (McCarthy).

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN pages returned empty, including its stories on Lamar Jackson, Kamara's knee and the Vikings' line. Hogs Haven, Bleeding Green Nation, Stampede Blue, Behind the Steel Curtain, Buffalo Rumblings, Acme Packing Company and the Star Tribune were blocked. RotoBaller gave navigation only and NBC Sports blurbs mostly a headline and one line. FantasyPros' and Sharp Football's defence-against-position tables did not render, so every matchup grade rests on FootballDB, which is standard scoring, with DraftEdge beside it. O'Connell's Monday press conference exists only as video. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Three receivers have unknown timelines, and anything offered would be priced on guesses. The window the strategy names is Weeks 9 to 11.

cannotSee.label: Next week
cannotSee.body: Minnesota and Miami are both off in Week 6: Jefferson, Addison, the Vikings' defence and Gordon. That is next Tuesday's problem and the main reason Coker's Week 6 return matters.
